title: Conductive polymer-coated nanocellulose enables dual-gradient thick electrodes for redox-homogeneous ultrahigh-areal-capacity Li-ion batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EE01622G, Paper
Ningxin Chen, Sida Xie, Jie Deng, Zichan Yuan, Zihan Guo, Kunkun Guo, Yue Ma, Chaoji Chen, Wenshuai Chen, Zhaohui Wang
A conductive nanocellulose scaffold turns sedimentation from a processing defect into a structure-directing tool, enabling compact dual-gradient thick electrodes with high areal capacity and redox homogeneity.
